|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB3-03-Captain_Yorr-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 11 November 2026). The release-sheet slip, the Players Committee card image and the Master List slip show the original words (see [[Captain Yorr (V)]], [[Captain Yorr (V) (Errata 2)]] and [[Captain Yorr (V) (Errata 3)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Captain Yorr (V)]]): Virtual Block 3 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 03)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 2, slip 03. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref>: “[Pilot] 2, 3: any starfighter. If your starship participating in battle is about to be excluded (even if that starship may not participate in battle) or made lost by opponent, you may choose for it to be ‘hit’ instead.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-03-Captain_Yorr.png]]) prints it. The slip prints slip number 03 at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC website card list, Virtual Block 3 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1230_3">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock3Type (Virtual Block 3 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205219/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “[Pilot] 2, 3: any starfighter. If your starship participating in a battle is about to be excluded (even if that starship may not participate in battle) or made lost by opponent, you may choose for it to be ‘hit’ instead.” '''What changed:''' One change: “a” is added (“participating in a battle”). The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Captain Yorr (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-D-captainyorr-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual3-Dark">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual3-Dark/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034607/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual3-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “[Pilot] 2, 3: any starfighter. If your starship participating in battle is about to be excluded (even if that starship may not participate in battle) or made lost by opponent, you may choose for it to be ‘hit’ instead.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It prints the same slip number as the release-sheet slip (03).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Captain Yorr (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 5)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1230-3-front-master.png]]: “[Pilot] 2, 3: any starfighter. If your starship participating in battle is about to be excluded (even if that starship may not participate in battle) or made lost by opponent, you may choose for it to be ‘hit’ instead.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word (the same words as the PC card image, PC-E2). The Master List slip prints no slip number. Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
